scenes.name: THE MAP WALL
lines: Start with a flower. Send a bouquet and a signed card to Blossom through the flower bot.
从一束花开始。通过花店机器人把花束和署名贺卡交给小花。
Follow the world-map wall. Nine mats in front, nine behind. Each basket has its own address.
沿着世界地图墙看，前后各九块垫子。每只花篮都有自己的编号。

scenes.name: READ A SEAT CODE
lines: Now book through Donna at the front desk. Read N1-17 as north stand, row one, seat seventeen.
再找前台 Donna 订座。N1-17 指北看台第一排十七号。
Face the stage. North and south hold 248 each. East and west hold 306 each. Eight tiers per stand, 1,108 seats in all.
四面看台围住舞台。南北各 248 席，东西各 306 席，每面八排，共 1,108 席。
Read across all four stands. The first three rows hold 144 seats apiece. The eighth holds 132.
按排汇总四面看台：前三排各 144 席，第八排有 132 席。

scenes.name: THE REHEARSAL CLOCK
lines: On November 27, Donna handled thirteen booking and check-in operations. Zero dropped. Median response, twenty-nine seconds.
11 月 27 日排练中，Donna 处理了 13 次订座和签到操作，零遗漏，响应中位数为 29 秒。
The seat glow took fifty-five to eighty-one seconds. Once all seats are booked, guest 1,109 gets the livestream link.
座位灯在 55 至 81 秒内亮起。满座后，第 1,109 位来宾收到直播链接。
